# Wrapped

This paragraph was wrapped by hand at a fixed width, which Obsidian shows as
two ragged lines instead of one flowing paragraph.
A third line of the same paragraph is reported only once.

- A list item that is long enough to have been wrapped by hand at a width
  onto a second line is broken the same way.
- A short item

One line is fine.

| a | b |
| - | - |
| 1 | 2 |

> [!NOTE]
> An alert on two lines
> is left alone.

**Asked:** label lines that each start bold are meant to sit on their own lines, like these two.
**Changed:** so they are not reported.
